build_marlin_linear_kernel: build a MarlinLinearKernel instance to apply GPTQ Marlin quantized linear operations on CUDA GPUs
test_marlin_supports_shape: test whether a given weight shape and group size is supported by the Marlin kernel
check_marlin_compatibility: check if a MarlinLinearKernel can implement a given MPLinearLayerConfig on the current platform
process_marlin_weights: process GPTQ weights after loading by repacking, permuting scales, and allocating a Marlin workspace
apply_marlin_weights: apply Marlin quantized weights to an input tensor using the GPTQ Marlin linear kernel
